rows.text: I heard the Spearlord is one bad egg. I want to fight against them — today — to see who's the baddest of the bad.
rows.speaker: Resentful Nymph

rows.text: But I've been waiting here all this time, and they still haven't shown up. Could they be cowering in awe at my reputation?
rows.speaker: Resentful Nymph

rows.text: Crrk... Is that who the Spearlord sent over? Super scary...
rows.speaker: Resentful Nymph
